hooks.command: pwsh -NoProfile -Command "$raw = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd(); try { $j = $raw | ConvertFrom-Json; $f = $j.tool_input.file_path } catch { exit 0 }; if (-not $f -or $f -notmatch 'docs[\\/].*\.md$') { exit 0 }; $banned = @{ 'execute|executed|executing|executes' = 'Use \'run\' or \'start\' instead'; 'right-select' = 'Use \'select\' instead'; 'navigate to' = 'Use \'open\' or describe the destination instead'; '\\blaunch\\b' = 'Use \'open\' or \'start\' instead'; '\\bcheckbox\\b' = 'Use \'option\' instead'; 'drop-down' = 'Use \'list\' instead'; '\\bclick\\b' = 'Use \'select\' instead' }; $found = $false; foreach ($pattern in $banned.Keys) { $hits = Select-String -Path $f -Pattern $pattern -CaseSensitive:$false -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($hits) { if (-not $found) { Write-Host \"TERMINOLOGY: $f\"; $found = $true }; foreach ($h in $hits) { Write-Host \"  Line $($h.LineNumber): [$pattern] — $($banned[$pattern])\" } } }"
